title: Louis introduces an African woman as his mother
summary: On a government goodwill tour of Africa before a crowd of over 100,000, Louis called an unknown African woman up to meet his mother.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I'd like to tell you something about Louie. See, we were sent to Africa by the government. You know, a goodwill tour.

So Louie, we were playing out in the field and the natives -- oh, there was over 100,000 people out there. And Louie -- we started playing something. So after we finished that one -- Lucille, his wife, was there -- and they had some African women around the stage. So he called one up. He said, "Folks, I want you to meet my mother." This African, he never saw her before in his life.
And the people just clapped and just hollered and everything and she was bashful -- she was something else. So that was his mother.
